name: Sterling-Nakamura Executive Medical Kit EMK-3
description: A compact medical kit designed for corporate executive protection details, containing automated diagnostic tools, rapid wound closure compounds, hemorrhage control agents, and three doses of broad-spectrum antitoxin. The EMK-3's centerpiece is its diagnostic scanner — a handheld device that performs a 30-second full-body assessment including blood chemistry, toxicology, and internal injury detection using ultrasound and bioimpedance sensing. The kit includes Lazarus Pharmaceuticals' Rapid Wound Closure Nanite injectors, military-grade hemostatic foam, and a neural interface crash kit for stabilizing augmentation failures.
legality: Licensed — medical professionals and authorized security
story_hooks: An EMK-3's diagnostic scanner has been modified to transmit the results of every scan to a third party — someone has been collecting medical data on every executive the kit has treated.

A counterfeit EMK-3 has surfaced with expired nanite injectors and diluted antitoxin — the counterfeits are packaged identically to genuine kits and have been distributed through legitimate supply chains.

physical_description.visual_profile: A sleek, professional-grade medical case with a distinctive two-tone design: matte charcoal upper panel with brushed steel lower compartment. The lid features an integrated diagnostic scanner head that retracts into the case. Angular, utilitarian aesthetic with soft-edge industrial styling. Appears purpose-built for rapid deployment by corporate security personnel.
physical_description.dimensions: 25cm width × 15cm depth × 8cm height — compact enough for a shoulder bag, roughly the size of a thick hardcover book
physical_description.weight_description: 2.1 kg — handheld but substantial; designed to be carried in a protective sling or mounted to corporate security tactical gear
physical_description.primary_material: Aerospace-grade aluminum alloy frame with impact-resistant polymer composite panels
physical_description.finish: Matte powder-coat on charcoal sections; brushed steel lower compartment with a subtle satin sheen. Edges are beveled and reinforced with nickel-plated corners
physical_description.color_scheme: Deep matte charcoal (RAL 7016) with polished steel accents; interior lined with medical-grade white and pale cyan sections. Accents of emerald green on diagnostic interface bezels
physical_description.interface_elements: Top-mounted diagnostic scanner with a small circular lens array (5cm diameter); recessed pressure-touch activation pad; secondary interface port on right side for neural crash kit connection; three individually labeled injection ports (color-coded: red for nanite, blue for antitoxin, green for foam). Small LED status indicator strip along the front edge cycling blue-to-green when functional
distinctive_features: Integrated scanner arm that extends 12cm when deployed, then retracts into lid for storage
Holographic AR overlay display on the inside of the lid showing real-time diagnostics
Sterling-Nakamura proprietary locking mechanism with biometric fingerprintensor on handle
Military-spec carry handle with rubberized grip and mounting points for carabiners
Translucent side panels revealing organized compartments for each medical compound
Thermally isolated compartments for temperature-sensitive pharmaceuticals (visible via faint frost patterns during use)
physical_description.manufacturer_markings: STERLING-NAKAMURA logo embossed in top-left corner; 'EMK-3' designation in small silver lettering; regulatory compliance stamps (GLMZ Medical Authority, North American Corp Standards); Lazarus Pharmaceuticals sub-license marking on nanite injection ports
physical_description.condition_typical: Pristine in professional environments; shows minor scuff marks and wear on handle corners from regular field use. Diagnostic lens may show slight residue from biological scanning. Interior compounds remain sealed in individual pods until deployment
